requirements.title: Identity and provenance
requirements.criterion: A selected history has stable source/definition, continuity, era, instance and visit identities, distinct from its display label.
proposedExpansion: Define historical counterpart relation separately from actual traveler identity and nested parent relation.
Freeze revision and source range per instance; new source material creates a reviewed revision/branch rather than changing already played history.
Model ordinary shared space, independent universe, branch, nested realm and merge as typed relations; none implies automatic cloning or authority.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: validateWorldDefinition/Instance/Endpoint/Records exist; createWorldInstance accepts continuityId/eraId/parentInstanceId. Native host registrations remain finite. A parent ID is not fork state.
acceptanceCases: Rename label without changing identity.
Two histories share one immutable definition and retain different facts.
Reject unknown definition revision before publication.
Nested parent does not give parent automatic knowledge/control.
remaining: Choose first represented source family and two histories.
Review identity namespaces across all affected native owners.

requirements.title: Historical snapshots and prior causes
requirements.criterion: Each selected before/during/after snapshot initializes causally coherent institutions, actors, stock and commitments without fabricating player deeds.
proposedExpansion: Represent settled prior events, ongoing events and future eligible events separately.
Late starts keep actual losses; early starts use contemporary bodies, offices, training and available materials.
Mid-event arrival exposes current actionable circumstances, without requiring the inherited Frontier opening.
A source endpoint is author context, not automatically character knowledge.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: chooseSimulationOrigin is one-time registered-origin effects, not a world/body/era initializer. createWorldInstance initializes supplied facts/sites, not a full historical snapshot.
acceptanceCases: Selected earlier era lacks later office and resources unless the variant explains them.
Late snapshot preserves unavailable participants and changed stock.
Mid-event start records ongoing causes without fake player receipts.
Reload/import retains selected era and prior causes.
remaining: Actual snapshot content and native initializer are not selected here.
G1 owns option candidates, weights and body legal-action proof.

requirements.title: Natural course and disturbance
requirements.criterion: An event occurs, changes or becomes ineligible because its actual causes and actor means changed.
proposedExpansion: Event card: stable ID, source anchor, predicates, participant identity/role, means, cause-relative window, effects, dependents and reports.
Record abstention, unsuccessful intervention, successful disturbance and later repair as distinct histories.
Recompute affected dependencies rather than invent universal butterfly effects.
A replacement actor requires its own motive, information, availability and means; similar outcomes may legitimately recur.
Inertia scores and role casting are optional models, never a license to force canon through removed causes.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: simulation events/controllers and causal effects exist in source; general source-event graph and disturbance resolver are not established by this review. Timeline C1-C6 remain proposals.
acceptanceCases: Abstention preserves eligible natural event.
Remove required communication/tool and event changes.
Failed intervention does not falsely mark the cause removed.
Independent surviving plan can produce a similar outcome.
Only dependent events change, and effects settle once.
remaining: Inspect exact chosen events/controllers and boundary scheduling before runtime packet.
Choose one local source-qualified event chain.

requirements.title: Parallel state isolation and fork transaction
requirements.criterion: Two instances of one selected family coexist without aliasing their local actors, objects, claims, knowledge or commitments.
proposedExpansion: Fork manifest declares copy/reference/remap/exclude for actors, items, sites, jobs, relationships, knowledge, claims, RNG and provenance.
Mutable counterpart IDs are instance-qualified; a shared source character name is not one custody account.
Actual traveler migration remains distinct from cloning.
Creation validates all downstream owners and publishes atomically; failure exposes neither a partial branch nor new rewards.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: World record/binding primitives and finite hosts exist. Glasshouse admits exactly one known instance; Paradise admits two exact footprints. Arbitrary same-family instances need generalized bindings to native owners.
acceptanceCases: Change stock in instance A and B remains unchanged.
Claim a local unique reward in A without consuming B unless selected shared scope says so.
Same display name keeps different relationship/knowledge ledgers.
Failed save leaves no half-created cast or branch.
An explicitly shared traveler is not cloned at both endpoints.
remaining: Determine exact owner scopes for the first fork.
Do not infer all-instance support from metadata constructors.

requirements.title: Local calendars and clock mapping
requirements.criterion: Displayed calendars, traveler exposure and deadline resolution follow declared mappings from one authoritative played clock.
proposedExpansion: Separate common played time, local calendar anchor, biological exposure, subjective time, hub time and transit time.
Specify rational rate, rounding carry, boundary order and calendar conversion; no wall-time inference.
Different calendar labels do not merge histories.
Transit delay, extraction deadline and contract settlement use their declared clocks.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: world_instances clock uses played_minutes. backlog_expansion_transit exposes explicit clock lanes/rational rates, but hub/local lanes require actual instance clocks at 1:1; other local rates need another admitted owner. This is source presence, not exercised behavior.
acceptanceCases: Two visitors union intervals rather than doubling world time.
Fractional mapping preserves residual across reload/import.
Travel crosses a local deadline exactly once.
New calendar anchor does not age a body retroactively.
Unsupported rate fails before publication.
remaining: Inspect selected transit consumer and native calendar owners.
No general unequal local world calendar is proven.

requirements.title: Presence, absence and offscreen resolution
requirements.criterion: Offscreen progress is bounded by the selected policy and actual supported actor activity, with discoverable return evidence.
proposedExpansion: Retain freeze, funded bounded actors/events, chapter snapshots and aggregate policies as separate options.
Declare what qualifies as presence: body visit, supported observation, authorized work, projected contact or other selected means.
Observation/work lease support has issuer/source/anchor/contact/expiry; losing support stops only affected advancement.
Materialize offscreen people with stable prior commitments; authored background is not a fake fully simulated economy.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: planWorldClock freezes unsupported absence; Glasshouse uses realm_clock_leases for supported observation/work. Finite lease consumer does not implement general offscreen history or offline years.
acceptanceCases: No active visit/support freezes local elapsed time.
Supported contact advances declared intervals once.
Expiry/lost source prevents unsupported production.
Return report arrives through an actual observer/channel.
Chapter jump preserves selected commitments and actual stock.
remaining: Select policy per world and declared resume scope.
Inspect exact aggregate/controller owners for bounded advancement.

requirements.title: Unequal, stopped and reversed temporal layers
requirements.criterion: A selected special-time mechanism affects only its declared layers, actors, processes and information channels.
proposedExpansion: Define stopped external clock versus active subjective processes, incoming signals, fuel use and body exposure.
Unequal rates require admitted local owners; stopped time must not imply every inhabitant stops or every actor can act.
Reversed elapsed history is a state transformation, not merely a negative scheduler tick.
Nested rates compose only where source mechanisms support them; track entry/exit and contact boundaries.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Carrier clock adapter has freeze/presence/supported lanes and rational rates for admitted clocks; native instance clock validates nonnegative forward played time. General reversed history needs transformation, and arbitrary stopped nested worlds are not proven.
acceptanceCases: Stopping one layer leaves unaffected external commitments running as declared.
Actor exposure differs from world calendar only under supported mapping.
A signal cannot arrive through a stopped channel unless the mechanism permits it.
Nested rates preserve exact residual and no double advancement.
Negative common-clock requests are rejected; authorized reversal uses its own scope.
remaining: Selected mechanism and exact actual consumer inspection pending.
No blanket temporal disadvantage or invented fuel cost.

requirements.title: Archives, chronicles and resume fidelity
requirements.criterion: Archived histories retain enough state to fulfill their declared readable or playable resume promises.
proposedExpansion: Archive header: identity, parent relation, revisions, selected policies and provenance; retain changed actors/custody/events/RNG/knowledge/commitments.
Offer full/pinned, delta with reconstructible frozen baseline, or explicitly lossy chronicle.
Lossy summary cannot promise exact historical playable restore.
Seed regeneration may fill never-committed background but never replaces actual prior stock, deaths, obligations or discoveries.
Measure storage on representative histories rather than adopting earlier size estimates.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Current instances/visits are not a full branch archive. Timeline seed-plus-canon and 10-50 KB estimates are proposals; broad reconstruction and atlas remain missing.
acceptanceCases: Pinned archive restores actual custody and open commitments.
Delta retains needed frozen baseline revision.
Chronicle clearly declares unavailable resume scope.
Missing content pack preserves opaque IDs without revealing private names.
Regrown background cannot create a previously lost item.
remaining: Choose supported archive modes and measure size/time.
Chronicle fade and branch threshold policies need continuity decisions.

requirements.title: Branch return, restoration and original baseline
requirements.criterion: Selecting a fresh baseline, re-entering a lived history and repairing that history produce distinct outcomes.
proposedExpansion: Support R1 new-run baseline, R2 travel between actual instances, R3 actual restoration and R4 regression through separate contracts.
An immutable source baseline is not itself an occupied live canon instance; instantiate when required.
Repair changes actual causes/actors and does not erase receipts or claim that past harm never occurred.
One persistent timeline is a valid alternate run policy.
Merge preserves conflicting people, obligations, custody and provenance under explicit rules.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Finite travel/revisit consumers exist; general branch selection, clean-baseline initializer, restoration merge and atlas travel are not established.
acceptanceCases: Return to lived instance retains previous changes.
Fresh baseline has a new identity without erasing old instance.
Repair does not retroactively grant unperformed achievements.
Blocked return reflects actual lost route.
Conflicting merges remain explicit rather than silently overwriting.
remaining: Select baseline versus persistent-history policy per world.
R3 matching canon is not proof that every historical record can merge.

requirements.title: Reset, loop and regression retention
requirements.criterion: Temporal reset restores and retains exactly the selected domains, including external observers, exports and RNG.
proposedExpansion: Transformation manifest lists body/source/memory/stock/custody/people/events/knowledge/RNG/claims/obligations and external domains.
Partial scenario reset, repeated trial, historical fork and full rollback remain distinct.
Explicit restore/duplicate cheats may recreate people/items when their mechanism permits; record new versus restored identity.
Replayed settlements are bugs only outside the selected repeat/duplication scope.
Define what remembered evidence survives when its cause no longer exists.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: checkpointScenario/rewindScenario restore one isolated scenario and retain campaign/journey/actors/worlds/random stream/receipts; sequence advances. Simulation reset policies exist but do not establish arbitrary full-world regression.
acceptanceCases: Scenario rewind does not change unrelated native body/inventory.
Authorized full restore affects every declared owner atomically.
External carried object follows selected duplicate/merge/fade rule.
RNG retained or restored exactly as declared across import.
Failed publication cannot leave a partial reset.
remaining: Exact selected cheat/world reset policy and owner set pending.
No universal conservation rule or compulsory cost.

requirements.title: Cross-history passage and carriers
requirements.criterion: A crossing moves or creates only what its actual mechanism permits and records resulting custody, obligations and local support.
proposedExpansion: Separate retained identity from usable power, office jurisdiction, fuel support and local access.
Body, memories, methods, sources, cargo, companions, curses, debts and duties have explicit directed-edge rules.
Interrupted arrival/return needs bounded state and clear actual location.
Counterpart-resonance/shared-account/duplication links are authored exceptions rather than inferred from matching names.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Realm endpoint/connections and carrierTransit context/snapshot/preview exist with actual owner binding; finite hosts support selected passages. Arbitrary actor migration/branch crossing still needs actual consumer qualification.
acceptanceCases: Retained office lacks authority in destination until locally recognized.
Borrowed object moves under actual custody.
Blocked fuel stops use without deleting held method/source.
Interrupted crossing leaves no actor or cargo at two unintended locations.
An explicitly authorized duplicate creates distinct provenance.
remaining: Inspect actual selected carrier publication consumer.
Companion identity and local source support joins require G2/G3 input.

requirements.title: Past selves, counterparts and recognition
requirements.criterion: Real counterparts and selves have distinct causal identities and recognize each other only through held means and evidence.
proposedExpansion: Trace records itinerary/milestones/relationships/key acts/habits at actual dates, with interpolation fidelity declared.
An undisturbed real past self follows eligible trace causes; disturbance yields new choices from goals/means rather than forced replay.
Soul, face and habits are compatible recognition routes; impressions may be wrong, partial or delayed.
A successor/heir is not predecessor mental mastery unless a carrier actually provides it.
Meet, warn, teach, trade, recruit, oppose or replace through actual local access and identity rules.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Actor knowledge, relationships and finite NPC controllers exist; general recorded-life actor, trace-to-controller adapter and counterpart identity bindings are not established.
acceptanceCases: Same face without prior evidence does not grant private knowledge.
Soul recognition works where held scope permits even with changed body.
Warned self deviates only after receiving credible information.
Distinct counterparts retain distinct kit and obligations.
Heir receives actual journal rather than automatic predecessor mastery.
remaining: Recorded versus generated identity and trace fidelity must be selected.
No automatic unique-item suppression when explicit duplicate mechanism exists.

requirements.title: Generated selves and future information provenance
requirements.criterion: A demonstration, projection, alternate possibility and real visiting self disclose their distinct fidelity and causal status.
proposedExpansion: Preserve perfect/extra-ability/projected/alternate/potential/shadow/worst/real-past/real-future families.
Generated models do not become actual people unless their mechanism creates them.
Model reveals only what its source can know; actual future sight grants its promised scope.
Projected habits or imagined ceilings remain readings rather than final destiny.
Optional coaching/replay can feed observed/understood learning only through declared acquisition.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Technique knowledge steps and actual actor ledgers are available foundations. General self transforms/replay actor realization require their own inspected implementation.
acceptanceCases: Model self cannot spend native goods without explicit commitment mechanism.
Real future visitor carries actual stale knowledge.
Projection changes when inputs change and labels prior result appropriately.
Strong true-sight scope may expose previously unknown facts through discovery route.
An optimal demonstration can report no winning line without inventing hidden tools.
remaining: G2 owns functional cards and optimization costs/performance.
Source-specific examples were not re-audited.

requirements.title: Actor-private knowledge and communication chains
requirements.criterion: Every actor responds to supported observation, inference, recollection or communication rather than author truth.
proposedExpansion: Knowledge record retains observer, target/history, cause, channel, attribution, timestamp, confidence and scope.
Communication requires actual message/report means, recipient and arrival timing; deception, interception and non-delivery are separate outcomes.
Institution escalation follows justified report and held resources, not enemy omniscience.
World event truth and local/public belief remain separate; absent observer sees aftermath only via supported route.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: simulation.knowledge is per actor with seen/interpreted/understood records, timestamp/cause/optional basis. projectSimulationAftermath uses observer ledger; addressed accounts require actual viewer recipient. General appraisal/communication network remains proposed.
acceptanceCases: NPC who never receives a warning does not react to its contents.
Messenger delay matters before event boundary.
False report can drive a mistaken actual action.
Private rival observation is absent from player notebook.
Strong held global communication bypasses ordinary travel delays if its scope supports it.
remaining: Inspect selected means and NPC planning consumers.
Confidence, origin-instance provenance and scalable message ordering need schema review.

requirements.title: Appraisal scope, uncertainty and staleness
requirements.criterion: Readings remain attributable moment-specific information and can become outdated without erasing what was actually observed.
proposedExpansion: Appraisal axes: target/channel/mode/range/time/schema/output/reliability/notice with confidence per field.
Unknown, blocked, unreadable, wrong-schema and absent results are distinct only when observer can distinguish them.
Separate equipped/base state, alias/legal/true name and current versus remembered location.
Changing conditions invalidates application of a prior reading; retain evidence and dated competing interpretations.
Means acquired/lost/restored changes future reading capability, not automatically historical memory.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Knowledge effect currently overwrites only at equal/higher seen/interpreted/understood rank. This is not a full contradictory/stale reading ledger; a lower-confidence corrective account can require a separate key/history rather than destructive downgrade. Action legibility retains attributed aftermath.
acceptanceCases: Observed equipped strength does not become timeless intrinsic strength.
Losing a lens stops new lens reads but keeps prior recorded account unless memory mechanism says otherwise.
A mistaken confident reading can coexist with corrective evidence.
Beyond-scope result does not reveal a hidden cause.
Authorized precise appraisal is not arbitrarily capped by generic AP ladder.
remaining: Choose per-field confidence and stale/history representation.
AP0-AP9 ladder, universal upkeep/counters/rank ceilings are examples, not laws.

requirements.title: Discovery routes and useful pre-certainty action
requirements.criterion: A selected mystery supports fitting investigation, useful actions before certainty and actual consequences of mistaken conclusions.
proposedExpansion: Retain unnoticed/sensed/suspected/known/usable as optional local stages distinct from generic ledger stages.
Routes can use skills, experiment, trusted testimony, inherited records or extraordinary means.
Comparing accounts, protective preparation, controlled tests, specialist commission and public/private disclosure can matter before full truth.
Discovery modifies access/use/treatment through actual means rather than simply incrementing a completion counter.
False rumors can be disproved; moving truths become stale; findings can be taught/traded/hidden under actual communication.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Knowledge/observation effects, action legibility and skill discovery modules exist; generic per-secret route evaluator and five-stage per-life records are not established by this inspection.
acceptanceCases: One useful preparation is reachable while merely suspicious.
Two fitting routes can reach the same selected revelation without leaking each other.
Mistaken hypothesis produces its declared consequence and can be revised.
Unshared discovery does not inform every NPC.
Truth change retains dated earlier evidence and new discovery.
remaining: No selected secret truth or candidate catalogue included.
Inspect exact skill discovery/native consumers for first chosen route.

requirements.title: Sealing, private packs and information-safe UI
requirements.criterion: Before its supported discovery route, hidden truth or candidate identity appears in no player-facing UI, hint, log, error, report or index.
proposedExpansion: Public requirement criteria remain generic; selected truth/variant/route particulars live in sealed or private owners.
Random truth/start selection freezes IDs and revision once; render/preview/failed save cannot reroll.
Do not reveal secret count or existence unless a selected disclosure route supports it.
Missing private pack preserves opaque state and uses neutral placeholders; no canon prose in export.
Fresh test origins may use debug unseal; never inspect director private saves.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: worldIdentityView hides unknown identity; worldInstanceView takes discovered/identityKnown/clockKnown and fact/site/actor/claim allowlists; action_legibility excludes hidden outcomes/private facts. Callers must derive those allowlists from actual actor means. No exhaustive leak audit is claimed.
acceptanceCases: Unknown identity leaves no revealing author checklist.
Supported discovery reveals only scoped fields.
Console/error/tooltip/disabled-action output contains no truth before route.
Reload/import preserves chosen hidden variant.
Unavailable pack does not reveal a sealed filename or source name.
remaining: Selected sealed reviewer must inspect truth separately.
Private franchise runtime location/public-build exclusion requires selected integration audit.

requirements.title: Archive import, conflicts and migration
requirements.criterion: Import validates histories and their dependencies without losing live play, rewriting conflicting identities or fabricating exact restoration.
proposedExpansion: Bundled live-save/atlas, separate atlas, allowed folder and optional explicit private sync remain distinct routes.
Same-ID divergent revisions require explicit conflict lineage rather than naive union; parent IDs do not prove compatibility.
Two independently played live runs can be retained as separate histories with verified owner mappings.
Checksums identify corruption but do not prove semantic consistency.
Missing referenced content requires preserved unresolved state or explicit non-playable chronicle, not silent mutable-history repair.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing save export/import and validators are foundations, not tested branch-atlas merge or live-run conversion. Per-world state validates exact supported revisions. General archive schema/migration remains pending.
acceptanceCases: Two unchanged identical archives are idempotent.
Same ID/different state retains both under explicit conflict policy.
Invalid parent/owner reference rejects affected restore before live publication.
Missing pack preserves neutral record for future compatible reader.
Failed import retains current live game unchanged.
remaining: Separate atlas semantics and migration scope need selected implementation.
No external sync authorization or acquisition in this pass.
